column4: dialect-gated: cleat#3378's regression test runs under forEachBackend, and the cluster job (ci.yml, ./engine/... with only CLEAT_TEST_DB set) runs Postgres only, so its mysql and mssql arms skip. CI reported the cluster pool at 617 against an allowance of 615 on PR #3384 (job 121380469787), which is these two.

Pairing line for the cluster entry above, required by scripts/check-skip-ledger-engine-coverage.py (cleat#2155): engine-race.yml checks this key with only CLEAT_TEST_DB (Postgres) set, so the same two arms skip there.
